en: The Philippine flag features a sun with exactly 8 rays, representing the first 8 provinces that revolted against Spanish colonial rule.
The Philippine Senate is composed of exactly 24 elected senators who serve a single, continuous term of six years.
The Philippine eagle, the national bird, stands about 1 meter tall and has a massive wingspan of up to 2 meters.
The Philippines has over 170 distinct living languages, with Filipino and English serving as the two official national languages.
The Giant Lantern Festival in San Fernando features massive winning lanterns that can contain over 15,000 individual light bulbs.
The Banaue Rice Terraces, built by the Ifugao people, are carved into the mountains at an altitude of about 1,500 meters.
National hero Jose Rizal wrote his final poem, 'Mi Ultimo Adios', which consists of exactly 14 stanzas with 4 lines each.
The 1987 Philippine Constitution contains exactly 18 Articles, including the fundamental Bill of Rights located in Article III.
Filipino scientist Dr. Ramon Barba discovered how to induce flowering in mango trees using a specific 1.5 percent potassium nitrate solution.
The Philippines is an archipelago composed of exactly 7,641 islands, which is 534 more than the previously counted 7,107 islands.
The historic Malolos Constitution was ratified by exactly 93 delegates of the Malolos Congress during the First Philippine Republic.
National Artist Nick Joaquin wrote over 40 books during his lifetime, including the famous novel The Woman Who Had Two Navels.
